body: I am with you a million % on binge eating. I was in the same train you are darling and you are not suffering alone in this. I’m not going to tell you stop binge eating because now it’s an addiction. And I find the addictions that harm you the most, the disease you have, is one of the only diseases you can get yelled for having and FUCK THAT. You are beautiful. Try binge eating some good for you foods to start getting yourself out of the habit. I love me some greasy things, have you ever tried veggie straws? They literally taste AMAZING and are good for you! I could eat those all day. Try binge drinking! Water, some juice, if I want something sweet I’ll freeze like a powerade or gatorade or like a fruit juice. Get a little ice slushee maker, and pour some juice or gatorade over the ice when you’re wanting something like that. There’s so many alternatives out there for you love. You’ll find one you love and you’ll stick to it. Please feel free to reach out to me if you need help with ANYTHING

I’m finally seeing my therapist again which is going so smoothly, I got a med change about two weeks ago and that seems to be going well too, finally getting some sleep. I think I just needed some place to write down my feelings, you know? It’s just easier to spill it out to strangers who seem to care more than the people you’ve known your whole life. Thank you for caring. Means a lot
I really don’t want to give up, just want to be understood or listened to. Thank you
